findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_compounds, find_studies, search_conditions, list_new_studies, check_claim · Private data: ask_greencyclepedia, search, fetch, search_compounds, get_compound, find_studies, get_cultivar, cite, get_changes, lookup_many, check_claim · Public sink: compare_compounds, lookup_many.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_compounds, find_studies, search_conditions, list_new_studies, check_claim · Private data: ask_greencyclepedia, search, fetch, search_compounds, get_compound, find_studies, get_cultivar, cite, get_changes, lookup_many, check_claim · Public sink: compare_compounds, lookup_many

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
